label: No self-giving of being from the indexed self-edge bridge
meaning: Conditional support for the strict no-self-giving premise 0e473dc4 of the causal Arrival B route (#1856). In any accessible history v at any moment t, a self-giving GivesAt v c c t would by the OPEN self-edge bridge b801eac6 be efficient self-causation of c's being in v at t, which the OPEN all-histories, all-moments no-self premise 4f1e13dd excludes. Both indices are kept throughout; nothing is moved from a possible history to the selected world. The passage from the being-giving family (GivesAt, 158301bc; CAUSE_OF_BEING 88a8fba7; CAUSING_AN_EFFECT c3c01e92) to efficient causing is made only by b801eac6. Both premises are analyst statements with attribution deferred; neither is the selected-time Aquinas statement 8b2561cd. Given #1856's equivalence (under 0e473dc4 and d3184c66 the nonexternal premise 2a4d99d8 is equivalent to e4a3b917), this support does not discriminate against a rival who denies that a necessary concretum is possible. No premise is established.
